mapper.select: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, total_cent, status, idempotent_key, seckill_activity_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalCent}, #{status}, #{idempotentKey}, #{seckillActivityId}) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO orders (user_id, total_cent, status, idempotent_key, seckill_activity_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalCent}, #{status}, #{idempotentKey}, #{seckillActivityId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, idempotent_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, qty, price_cent) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{qty}, #{priceCent})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotent_key = #{key}
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'REFUNDED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAID'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.seckill_activity_id = #{activityId} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED'
